plugin.name: MiniMax
plugin.description: Generate videos and character speech with your MiniMax account.
plugin.longDescription: Adds separate China and Global video providers. Supports text, first/last frames and up to nine reference images. Stop ends local waiting; the remote task may continue and incur charges. Compatible app versions can move existing MiniMax settings into this plugin. Speech 2.8 HD/Turbo adds single-speaker speech, six system voice presets, speed/pitch/volume and MP3/WAV. China and Global retain separate keys. Account voice discovery, cloning and music are not included.
config.cn.title: China API key
config.cn.description: From platform.minimax.cn → API Keys. Only needed for the China provider.
config.global.title: Global API key
config.global.description: From platform.minimax.io → API Keys. Only needed for the Global provider.
